name: rolo-loop
description: Turns an AI coding agent chat (Claude Code or a compatible CLI) into an orchestrator for loop engineering: roadmap, spec, review gate, implement, verify, quality gate, run by subagents with on-disk state and a PreToolUse guard hook. The unattended loop runs in the Rolo Loop app (desktop or harness serve) from the same repository: graph view of the roadmap, approve, answer, instruct, deliver, on your subscription or a pay-per-use API key, in the order you choose.
